description: Metro / Outer Metro Bus Contract boundaries is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Greater Sydney Metropolitan and Outer Sydney Metropolitan Bus Service Contracts Boundaries. Bus Service Contracts are contracts issued by the Government of New South Wales to metropolitan bus operators and outer metropolitan bus operators to operate their public bus route network. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are GSBC, OMBSC, OSMBSC, boundaries, buses. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, map. The portal shows 2024-10-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
